dct_description_sm: These data were collected opportunistically during a cruise of the CCGS P. Radisson from Churchill, Manitoba to the estuary of the Nelson River. This dataset was collected in a collaborative study of carbon fluxes in the estuary of the Nelson River together with researchers Tim Papakyriakou (Centre for Earth Observations Science, University of Manitoba) and Lisa Miller (Institute of Ocean Sciences, Department of Fisheries and Oceans, Sydney, BC), who made carbon flux-related observations at each station. This data also serves to supplement a data record for which collection began previously in Hudson Bay in continuing University of Manitoba studies of freshwater-marine interactions in Hudson Bay. These studies include freshwater sources (fluvial and ice-melt), distribution and circulation in Hudson Bay and Hudson Strait, nutrient and sediment loading from two major rivers (the Nelson River and the Rivire de la Grande Baleine), and optical effects of CDOM (colored dissolved organic matter) and sediments on the littoral of Hudson Bay.

dct_title_s: Water quality in southern Hudson Bay, autumn 2013
